newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Great Central signs A$150 mln facility.
newsitem.headline: Great Central signs A$150 mln facility.

text.p: Gold miner and explorer Great Central Mines Ltd said on Friday it had signed a syndicated revolving multi-currency bank debt facility for A$150 million.
The facility was signed with Societe Generale Australia, UBS Australia, Credit Suisse First Boston and The Chase Manhattan Bank, it said.
Chase Securities Australia had been appointed facility agent.

"The successful completion of this facility on competitive terms moves the company from being financed on a secured 'project' basis to borrowing on an 'unsecured' basis," Great Central Chairman and Managing Director Joseph Gutnick said in a statement.
